A '''Iajik whip''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lariss]] carried a Iajik whip after obtaining one on a campaign.

==Behind the scenes==
In "To Free the Forgotten," this item's sole appearance, it is called "a Iajik whip," the use of "a" rather than "an" indicating that "Iajik" is pronounced with a leading consonant rather than vowel sound.
